The energy balance calculator achieved a perfect reward score by successfully passing the legacy pytest suite without exceptions.
The execution resulted in a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.88, with zero exceptions across all trials. The test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite passed in 0.318 seconds using pytest version 8.4.1. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check the weighting assumptions to improve the judge_reward toward a perfect 1.0.
